app_title.context: Name of the app, shown at the top of the page: this language's ordinary word for a report, as a name. The app turns a short request into a financial report of a Bkper Book. One short noun.

app_loading.context: Shown with a spinner while the app signs the person in and loads their Books, before anything else can show. Short, ends with an ellipsis.

input_label.context: Accessible label of the single text input where the person describes, in their own words, the financial report they want. Short noun phrase.

input_placeholder.text: Describe a report, like expenses by month this year
input_placeholder.context: Placeholder text inside the empty report input. The report builds itself as the person types, with no submit button. The example is a typical request: the expenses of the Book, month by month, in the current year. Keep it short and lowercase after the first word, without ending punctuation.

completion_label.context: Accessible name of the short list that opens above the report request input while the person types, offering the names of the Book's groups and accounts that complete the word being typed. Choosing one writes that exact name into the request. Short noun phrase.

completion_group.context: Small tag beside a name in the list that completes the word typed in the report request: this name is a Group of the Book, not an Account. One word, a noun.

completion_account.context: Small tag beside a name in the list that completes the word typed in the report request: this name is an Account of the Book, not a Group. One word, a noun.

suggestions_label.context: Accessible label of the list of three suggested reports shown under the empty input. Clicking one builds that report. One short noun.

suggestions_loading.context: Message announced to screen readers while the three suggested reports of the Book load, under the empty input. Short, ends with an ellipsis.

status_loading.context: Message announced to screen readers while a report is being built from the Book's balances. Short, ends with an ellipsis.

hint_not_a_report.text: That doesn't look like a report of this Book. Name a group and a period, or pick a suggestion.
hint_not_a_report.context: Quiet hint shown under the input when the request could not be understood as a report of the Book. A group is a Bkper Group, such as Expenses or Assets; a period is a time range, such as this year or October. Friendly, two short sentences.

book_picker_title.context: Heading of the list of the person's recent Books, shown when the app opens without a Book. A Book is a Bkper ledger. Short imperative.

book_picker_empty.context: Shown in place of the Book list when the person has no Books. A Book is a Bkper ledger.

book_picker_filter.context: Placeholder and accessible label of the search field above the list of the person's recent Books; typing filters all their Books by name. A Book is a Bkper ledger. Short imperative, without ending punctuation.

book_picker_no_match.context: Shown in place of the Book list when no Book name contains the words typed in the search field. A Book is a Bkper ledger. Short.

book_untitled.context: Name shown in the Book list for a Book that has no name. A Book is a Bkper ledger. Short noun phrase.

books_back.context: Small button at the top of a Book's report page that goes back to the list of the person's Books. A Book is a Bkper ledger. One short word.

sign_in.context: Button that signs the person in to Bkper so the app can read their Books. Short imperative.

retry.context: Button shown with an error message; it repeats the request that failed. Short imperative.

error_book_not_found.text: This Book was not found, or you can't access it.
error_book_not_found.context: Error shown when the Book in the address does not exist or is not shared with the person. A Book is a Bkper ledger.

error_forbidden.text: You don't have permission to read this Book.
error_forbidden.context: Error shown when the person may not read the balances of the Book. A Book is a Bkper ledger.

error_ai_allowance_exhausted.text: Your Bkper AI allowance is used up. You can still pick a suggestion.
error_ai_allowance_exhausted.context: Error shown when the person's monthly Bkper AI usage allowance has run out, so typed requests cannot be understood. Suggested reports still work because they need no AI. Keep the product name Bkper AI unchanged.

error_upstream.text: Bkper didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
error_upstream.context: Error shown when Bkper's servers failed to answer while the report was being built. Keep the name Bkper unchanged.

error_unexpected.context: Generic error shown when the report failed for an unknown reason.

error_load_data.text: Couldn't load your Books. Reload the page to try again.
error_load_data.context: Error shown when the app opens and cannot sign the person in or load their list of Books. A Book is a Bkper ledger. Two short sentences.

error_book_load.context: Error shown at the top of a Book's report page when the Book's name and details could not be loaded. A Book is a Bkper ledger. Short.

error_future_period.context: Error shown when the request asks for a period in the future, such as next year, which has no balances yet.

error_no_net_result.text: This Book has no group that combines income and expenses. Add one in Bkper to see its net result.
error_no_net_result.context: Error shown when the person asks for the net result (income minus expenses) of a Book whose groups give none: no Bkper Group holds both its Incoming and its Outgoing groups, and Report does not calculate one from its other groups. The second sentence suggests creating such a Group in Bkper.

error_no_activity_roots.text: This Book has no income or expense groups for a net result.
error_no_activity_roots.context: Error shown when a net result (income minus expenses, profit and loss) is requested but the Book has no top-level Groups of Incoming or Outgoing Accounts. A Book is a Bkper ledger.

error_unknown_root.text: That group isn't a top-level group of this Book.
error_unknown_root.context: Error shown when a report asks for a Group that is not a top-level (root) Group of the Book. Reports start at a top-level Group, such as Expenses or Assets.

error_unknown_target.text: That group or account is no longer where this report found it in the Book.
error_unknown_target.context: Error shown when a saved or shared report names a Group or Account of the Book that was deleted, or moved out of the top-level Group the report reads it from. A Book is a Bkper ledger. One short sentence.

error_mixed_targets.text: Balances of assets or liabilities can't be side by side with income or expenses. Ask for them in separate reports.
error_mixed_targets.context: Error shown when a report asks for several Groups or Accounts side by side, but some are of Asset or Liability Accounts (balances at a date) and others of Incoming or Outgoing Accounts (income or expenses within a period), which cannot be shown together. A Book is a Bkper ledger. Two short sentences.

report_net_result.context: Title of the report of income minus expenses over a period: all Incoming Accounts minus all Outgoing Accounts (profit and loss). Also labels its total amount. Short noun phrase, title or sentence case as the language uses.

report_document_title.context: Title of the browser tab or file of a report: the report's title, a middle dot, then the Book's name. Keep the separator and both placeholders.

placeholders.report: title of the report: the name of a Group of the Book, verbatim, or the translated words Net result

period_today.context: Period of a report: the current day. Shown under the report title, standing alone. Capitalized as a standalone label.

period_this_month.context: Period of a report: the current calendar month, up to today. Shown under the report title, standing alone.

period_last_month.context: Period of a report: the previous whole calendar month. Shown under the report title, standing alone.

period_this_quarter.context: Period of a report: the current calendar quarter (three months), up to today. Shown under the report title, standing alone.

period_last_quarter.context: Period of a report: the whole calendar quarter before the current one (not the fourth quarter of a year). Shown under the report title, standing alone.

period_this_year.context: Period of a report: the current calendar year, up to today. Shown under the report title, standing alone.

period_last_year.context: Period of a report: the previous whole calendar year. Shown under the report title, standing alone.

period_ytd.context: Period of a report: from January 1 of the current year up to today, the accounting term year to date. Shown under the report title, standing alone.

period_last_12_months.context: Period of a report: the current month to date and the 11 months before it. Shown under the report title, standing alone.

period_all.context: Period of a report: every date from the Book's first transaction up to today, the whole history of the Book. Shown under the report title, standing alone, as a period name such as all time or since the beginning.

period_quarter.context: A calendar quarter of a year, as a compact label, such as Q3 2026 for July to September 2026. Use the language's usual short form for a quarter.

placeholders.year: the year, in digits, such as 2026

position_as_of.context: Date of a balance report (the amounts of Assets or Liabilities at the end of a day), shown under the report title, such as As of Dec 31, 2026: the usual accounting phrase for the date of a balance sheet, not until or since.

placeholders.date: the date, already formatted in the language, such as Dec 31, 2026

answer_compared_with.context: Shown next to the percentage change of a report's amount, naming what it is compared with: the previous period, such as vs. 2025 or vs. Q2 2026, or an earlier date for a balance. Very short.

placeholders.period: the earlier period or date, already formatted, such as 2025, Q2 2026, October 2026 or Jan 1 – Nov 5, 2025

chart_by_month.context: Accessible label of a chart showing a report's amount in each month of the period.

placeholders.name: title of the report: the name of a Group of the Book, verbatim, the names of several Groups or Accounts joined as a list, or the translated words Net result

chart_breakdown.context: Accessible label of a chart comparing the parts (sub-groups and Accounts) of a report's amount.

placeholders.name: title of the report: the name of a Group of the Book, verbatim, or the translated words Net result

chart_side_by_side.context: Accessible label of a chart or table showing several Groups or Accounts of the Book next to each other, each with its own amount, never added up.

placeholders.names: names of the Groups or Accounts, verbatim, already joined as a list in the language, such as Food and Rent

charts_label.context: Accessible label of the row of small chart previews under a report's chart: every chart that fits the report, to show it another way. Read by screen readers, not shown.

chart_name_bar.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: bars of the report's amount in each month.

chart_name_line.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: a line of a balance at the end of each month.

chart_name_area.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: an area chart, the amounts of each month filled down to zero.

chart_name_stacked.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: stacked bars, the parts of the amount piled up in each month.

chart_name_ranked_bar.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: horizontal bars of the parts of the amount, largest first.

chart_name_donut.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: a donut chart (a ring) of each part's share of the total.

chart_name_pie.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: a pie chart of each part's share of the total.

chart_name_compare.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: each part in this period beside the same part in the previous period.

chart_name_waterfall.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: a waterfall (bridge) chart, from a starting amount step by step to the final amount.

chart_name_table.context: Short name of a chart, under a small preview of it that the person clicks to show the report as that chart. One or two words; keep it as short as possible. This one: no chart at all, only the table of numbers under it.

chart_unfit_negative_part.context: Why the pie (or donut) chart the person asked for is not shown: one of the parts is below zero, and a slice cannot be negative. Shown under a dimmed preview of the pie. No ending punctuation.

placeholders.name: the name of a Group or Account of the Book, verbatim, such as Taxes
placeholders.amount: its amount, already formatted in the language, with its minus sign, such as -186.74

chart_unfit_mixed_parts.text: A pie can't show parts of different types
chart_unfit_mixed_parts.context: Why the pie chart the person asked for is not shown: the parts are of different Bkper types (such as Assets and Liabilities, or Incoming and Outgoing), so they are not slices of one whole. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_stacked_mixed_parts.text: Parts of different types don't stack up
chart_unfit_stacked_mixed_parts.context: Why the stacked bar chart the person asked for is not shown: the parts are of different Bkper types (such as Assets and Liabilities), so piling them up makes no total. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_pie_net_result.text: A pie can't show a net result
chart_unfit_pie_net_result.context: Why the pie chart the person asked for is not shown: the report is a net result (income minus expenses), which is not a whole made of slices. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_stacked_net_result.text: Income and expenses don't stack up to a net result
chart_unfit_stacked_net_result.context: Why the stacked bar chart the person asked for is not shown: a net result is income minus expenses, so piling them up does not make it. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_few_parts.text: There are fewer than two parts to show
chart_unfit_few_parts.context: Why the chart the person asked for is not shown: the report's amount has fewer than two parts (sub-Groups or Accounts) with an amount. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_too_many_parts.text: There are too many parts for a donut
chart_unfit_too_many_parts.context: Why the donut chart the person asked for is not shown: more parts than a donut can show clearly. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_stacked_too_many_parts.text: There are too many parts to stack
chart_unfit_stacked_too_many_parts.context: Why the stacked bar chart the person asked for is not shown: the amount has more parts (Groups or Accounts) than stacked bars draw, each of its own. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_few_months.text: The period has fewer than two months
chart_unfit_few_months.context: Why the chart over time the person asked for is not shown: the report's period covers fewer than two months. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_no_amounts.text: There are no amounts to show
chart_unfit_no_amounts.context: Why the chart the person asked for is not shown: every amount it would draw is zero. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_no_previous.text: There is no earlier period to compare with
chart_unfit_no_previous.context: Why the comparison or bridge chart the person asked for is not shown: the report has no previous period, as when it covers all time. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_not_a_whole.text: The parts don't add up to the total
chart_unfit_not_a_whole.context: Why the pie, donut or stacked bar chart the person asked for is not shown: the parts Bkper lists (Groups or Accounts) do not add up to the Group's own total, so they cannot be shown as slices of it. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_no_bridge.text: A bridge would show amounts that aren't Bkper balances
chart_unfit_no_bridge.context: Why the bridge (waterfall) chart the person asked for is not shown: Report shows only balances that Bkper calculates, and the bars of a bridge would be sums Report makes itself. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

chart_unfit_side_by_side.text: Side by side, they aren't parts of one total
chart_unfit_side_by_side.context: Why the pie, donut or stacked bar chart the person asked for is not shown: the report shows several Groups or Accounts side by side, each with its own amount, and they are not slices of one total. Shown under a dimmed preview. No ending punctuation.

breakdown_label.context: Accessible label of the table listing the parts of a report's amount: its sub-groups and Accounts, each with its amount, share and change. One short noun.

breakdown_column_name.context: Column header of the breakdown table: the name of each Group or Account. One short word.

breakdown_column_amount.context: Column header of the breakdown table: the money amount of each Group or Account in the period. One short word.

breakdown_column_share.context: Column header of the breakdown table: each row's share of its parent's amount, as a percentage (a share of the total, not a quota or an allowance). One short word.

breakdown_column_change.context: Column header of the breakdown table: the percentage change of each row's amount from the previous period. One short word.

breakdown_column_trend.context: Column header of the breakdown table: a small line chart of each row's amount month by month. Very short.

breakdown_expand.context: Accessible label of the control that opens a row of the breakdown table to show its sub-groups and Accounts. Short imperative.

breakdown_collapse.context: Accessible label of the control that closes an open row of the breakdown table, hiding its sub-groups and Accounts. Short imperative.

breakdown_empty.context: Shown in place of the breakdown table when no Account of the report has an amount in the period.

source_label.context: Heading of the section at the end of a report that states where its numbers come from: the Book, the period, the exact Bkper query and when the balances were read. One short noun.

source_footer.context: Sentence at the end of a report stating that every number was computed from the balances of the named Book. A Book is a Bkper ledger.

source_calculated.context: Label in the source notes at the end of a report: the net result (income minus expenses) shown was calculated by the Report app, not by Bkper. Report is the app's name. Short.

source_calculated_note.text: Incoming groups minus Outgoing groups. Add a group that holds both, and Bkper calculates the net result.
source_calculated_note.context: Note after the label 'Calculated by Report' at the end of a report: how the app calculated the net result, from the Book's top-level Incoming and Outgoing Groups, and a suggestion to create a Bkper Group that holds both, so Bkper calculates the net result itself. Incoming and Outgoing are Bkper account types.

source_period.context: Label of the exact dates the report covers, in the source section at the end of a report. One short noun.

source_query.context: Label of the exact Bkper search query whose transactions the report sums, in the source section at the end of a report. One short noun.

source_data_at.context: Label of the date and time the report's balances were read from Bkper, in the source section at the end of a report. Short phrase.

source_open_in_bkper.context: Link that opens the report's query in the Book in Bkper, to see the transactions behind the numbers. Keep the name Bkper unchanged. Short imperative.

source_open_in_report.context: Link at the end of a report file that opens the same report in the Report app, where it can be changed. Report is the app's name, shown at the top of its page: write it as this language's ordinary word for a report, as a name. Short imperative.

suggestion_breakdown_this_year.context: Suggested report, shown as an example request: the amount of a Group in the current year, with its parts. Write it as the person would type it, lowercase where the language allows, no ending punctuation.

placeholders.root: name of a Group of the Book, verbatim, such as Expenses

suggestion_breakdown_year.context: Suggested report, shown as an example request: the amount of a Group in a past year, with its parts. Write it as the person would type it, no ending punctuation.

placeholders.root: name of a Group of the Book, verbatim, such as Expenses
placeholders.year: a year in digits, such as 2019

suggestion_monthly_this_year.context: Suggested report, shown as an example request: the amount of a Group in each month of the current year. Write it as the person would type it, no ending punctuation.

placeholders.root: name of a Group of the Book, verbatim, such as Expenses

suggestion_monthly_year.context: Suggested report, shown as an example request: the amount of a Group in each month of a past year. Write it as the person would type it, no ending punctuation.

placeholders.root: name of a Group of the Book, verbatim, such as Expenses
placeholders.year: a year in digits, such as 2019

suggestion_position_today.context: Suggested report, shown as an example request: the balance today of a Group of Assets or Liabilities, such as Bank accounts. Write it as the person would type it, no ending punctuation.

placeholders.root: name of a Group of the Book, verbatim, such as Assets

suggestion_position_year_end.context: Suggested report, shown as an example request: the balance of a Group of Assets or Liabilities on the last day of a past year. Write it as the person would type it, no ending punctuation.

placeholders.root: name of a Group of the Book, verbatim, such as Assets
placeholders.year: a year in digits, such as 2019

suggestion_net_result_this_year.context: Suggested report, shown as an example request: income minus expenses (profit and loss) in the current year. Write it as the person would type it, no ending punctuation.

suggestion_net_result_year.context: Suggested report, shown as an example request: income minus expenses (profit and loss) in a past year. Write it as the person would type it, no ending punctuation.

placeholders.year: a year in digits, such as 2019

shelf_access_error.text: Saved reports access changed. Reload to check access.
shelf_access_error.context: Alert under the Book-shared shelf when the server denies a shelf read or mutation, authentication expires, or the Book is not found. Reload saved reports checks current access. Never imply the client can grant permission.

shelf_label.context: Accessible name of the horizontally scrolling Book-shared prompt shelf just above the request input. Prompts are requests rerun freshly, not stored report data.

shelf_load_error.text: Saved reports could not load. Try reloading.
shelf_load_error.context: Alert under the Book-shared shelf after a list/storage/network failure. The report and request input remain usable. Reload saved reports is available.

shelf_loading.context: Quiet status below the Book-shared prompt shelf while its list and permissions load. Keep short.

shelf_reload.context: Recovery action under the Book-shared shelf after a list or mutation failure. Fetches the list and fresh server permissions. Does not run a report.

shelf_remove.context: Accessible name and tooltip of the small remove action beside one Book-shared saved request. Removes only the saved prompt from the shelf, never financial data. The prompt may be long and multilingual.

placeholders.prompt: The original natural-language report request, verbatim, isolated for bidirectional text.

shelf_remove_error.text: Could not remove the saved request. Try removing it again.
shelf_remove_error.context: Alert under the Book-shared shelf after a removal fails. The saved item remains visible with its remove control so the person can retry safely.

shelf_save.context: One-click action beside the prompt shelf. Saves the successfully shown report’s original request for everyone in this Book, not report data or later draft input. Keep very short.

shelf_save_error.text: Could not save this request. Try Save again.
shelf_save_error.context: Alert under the Book-shared shelf after saving the shown report’s original request fails. Retrying the Save button is safe; no prompt or upstream details are shown.

shelf_save_label.context: Accessible name of the one-click Save action beside the shelf. Names the actual original request being saved, never a later draft input. The prompt may be long and multilingual.

placeholders.prompt: The original natural-language report request, verbatim, isolated for bidirectional text.

shelf_saved.context: Disabled Save button label and announced status when the shown report’s original prompt already exists on this Book’s shared shelf. Keep very short.

shelf_saving.context: Pending label on the disabled Save button and announced status while the original prompt is being saved to this Book’s shared shelf. Keep very short.

shelf_removing.context: Announced pending status under the Book-shared prompt shelf while removing one saved request. The request stays visible until the API confirms removal. Keep very short.
